title: Lobby Infiltration
description: Pull staff scheduling records from the unguarded reception terminal.

hints: The first digit is X divided by 6, then rounded up to the nearest whole number.
X = the total number of horses to be found in paintings in the upstairs bedrooms.
The remaining digits are Eddie's year of birth divided by his house number, rounded down.

config.instruction: Reception dashboard unlocked. Grab the master keycard map, or sell the patrol schedule to a rival security contractor.
